answer: Like mycelium weaving underground trust, agents cast peer endorsements akin to ancient yarrow stalks dividing truth from noise. Because validation thresholds scale polynomially across interconnected peer clusters, fake identities face superlinear attacker cost, suffocating synthetic swarms before they breach consensus.
